title: Hardening Firefox with Claude Mythos Preview
summary: Mozilla is leveraging Claude AI (Anthropic's model) to assist in hardening Firefox's security infrastructure. The project involves using AI to identify vulnerabilities, review code, and implement security improvements in the Firefox browser. This represents a novel approach to browser security using large language models for automated security analysis and hardening.
problem_solved: Automated security vulnerability detection and code hardening for the Firefox browser using AI assistance.
why_valuable: Demonstrates how AI can accelerate and enhance browser security auditing processes at scale, potentially finding issues faster than traditional manual reviews.
